title: Communication Resources | Ticks | CDC
content: Communication Resources Key points CDC has developed tools to help state and local health departments prevent tickborne disease. You can also find disease-specific resources for Lyme disease, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, and babesiosis on their respective websites.
